prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A fast guide to spending three days in Lisbon, with what to see and what to eat each day. Hills, trams, custard tarts and grilled fish in one short plan.

beats.narration: Three days in Lisbon is enough to fall for it. Day one: climb the hills, ride the yellow tram, and eat a custard tart.
Day two: wander the riverside and the old Belém area. Then sit down to grilled fresh fish with a cold glass of wine.

image_queries: Lisbon custard tarts pastel de nata

beats.narration: Day three: get lost in Alfama, listen for fado at night, and watch the sunset from a viewpoint. Lisbon rewards slow walkers.
